page.overview:
What is Sedmelluq?

Sedmelluq is a colossal glowing worm with a star-shaped mouth dwelling in a subterranean beneath Greenland. It made its first and only appearance to date in Imagon, a German-language Mythos novel by Michael Marrak. Imagon extends the Cthulhu Mythos following the events of H. P. Lovecraft's At the Mountains of Madness.

It is worshipped by the extraterrestrial Mi-Go.
